title: UI风格#24 - Space Cosmic (宇宙星空)
description: 创建第24种UI风格：宇宙星空风格 - 深空蓝黑、星云色彩、粒子星光。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planX.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Space Cosmic style When color palette Then features deep space blues, nebula purples, star whites, cosmic dust
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#0B0B2B (深空), #1A1A4E (星空蓝), #6B5B95 (星云紫), #FFD700 (星尘金), #FFFFFF (星光白)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Space Cosmic style When typography Then uses cosmic fonts: Orbitron, Exo 2, or Space Grotesk
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Orbitron (显示), Exo 2 (正文), Space Grotesk (替代)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Space Cosmic style When layout Then star fields, nebula gradients, orbital paths, constellation lines
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：星场背景、星云渐变、轨道路径、星座连线

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Space Cosmic style When UI elements Then twinkling stars, glowing orbs, nebula borders, orbit animations
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：闪烁星光、发光球体、星云边框、轨道动画

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Space Cosmic UI When functional Then includes cosmic chat, stellar agents, orbital stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：宇宙聊天、恒星代理、轨道统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Space Cosmic UI When copy Then uses cosmic language: 'Nebula', 'Orbit', 'Stellar', 'Cosmos'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'NEBULA. ORBIT. STELLAR.'、按钮'SEND'→'TRANSMIT'、'SUBMIT'→'LAUNCH'
